description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the LDAPUserSyncAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests LDAP user synchronization functionalities, including getOne and create operations, along with configuration setup hooks and unimplemented API methods.

classes.name: LDAPUserSyncAPITest
